title: Value Band Addition to Death Benefit Valuation Interest — Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
Larger Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contracts earn a value band addition when their death benefit is valued.

**Rule.** The valuation value band addition is **0.10% (0.001)** where the contract value at the most recent interest credit is at least **$300000**, **0.05% (0.0005)** where it is at least **$250000** but under $300000, and nothing otherwise. The addition is added to each rate at which the death benefit valuation interest is worked.

**Contract value at the most recent interest credit.** As the activity history stands: premiums received plus interest credited, less withdrawals, surrender charges and death benefit payments.

| Contract value at the most recent interest credit | Addition |
|---|---|
| $300000.00 or more | 0.10% |
| $250000.00 to $299999.99 | 0.05% |
| Under $250000.00 | Nothing |

*Worked case (hypothetical):* a contract value of $260000.00 at the most recent interest credit and a guaranteed rate of 5.10% give valuation interest worked at 5.15%.
